context_varying_parameters.name: age
context_varying_parameters.reason: Distinct source eligibility/margins and broader unbounded target age support require context-specific age families; within-bin source completion and target shape remain assumptions.

context_varying_parameters.name: female_probability
context_varying_parameters.reason: MIND ratio2049/3547 and Ayele ratio586/872 describe different source recruitment. Target0.56 is a declared composition scenario with no target counts.

context_varying_parameters.name: bmi
context_varying_parameters.reason: MIND supplies two moments; Ayele supplies literal category counts and endpoints. Target broader lognormal moments and source within-category shapes are explicit assumptions.

context_varying_parameters.name: glucose_baseline
context_varying_parameters.reason: Only MIND supplies a continuous source glucose marginal. Ayele and target basal location/dispersion are assumption-defined separate contexts anchored loosely to MIND, not converted assay-equivalent estimates.

context_varying_parameters.name: sex_rank_shifts
context_varying_parameters.reason: Sex-specific age and BMI distributions can differ by selection and context. All shifts, including glucose sex shift, are unsupported structural choices, with source and target marginals preserved by the mixture CDF.

context_varying_parameters.name: feeding
context_varying_parameters.reason: MIND overnight fasting, Ayele mixed/repeated capillary measurements and target pooled POC require distinct feeding scenarios. Probabilities and increment distribution are not reported estimates.

context_varying_parameters.name: poc_measurement
context_varying_parameters.reason: Preserve MIND observed serum marginal, model Ayele three-day averaging, and separately model target single pooled POC readings. Bias/noise constants are unvalidated assumptions, not assay conversions.
